newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-INTERNAZIONALE CRUISE INTO LAST EIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTERNAZIONALE CRUISE INTO LAST EIGHT.

text.p: Internazionale Milan, buoyed by a 5-1 first-leg victory, cruised into the UEFA Cup quarter-finals when they beat Portuguese first division Boavista 2-0 in the second leg on Tuesday.
Boavista missed a fine chance to score in the fifth minute, Surinamese striker Jerrel Jimmy shooting wide, and they soon found themslves trailing on the night after giving away a penalty.
Boavista's goalkeeper Alfredo Castro fouled midfielder Marco Branca in the 12th minute, and French striker Youri Djorkaeff slotted home the spot kick.
England midfielder Paul Ince scored Inter's second goal in the 66th minute from a pass by Chilean Ivan Zamorano.
Boavista, whose defeat in the first leg cost the job of Montenegran coach Zoran Filipovic, did get the ball into the net a minute from the final whistle but Sasa Simic's effort was ruled offside.
